name: AlphaPing
notes: Risk curator that operates vaults on Morpho, Euler, TermMax, IPOR. No own protocol contracts and no public AlphaPing-specific indexer; their vault positions are indexed by the host protocols' own subgraphs (e.g. Morpho).

name: Mainstreet
notes: Mainstreet-Labs org has only mainstreet-core (Solidity contracts), an audit repo, and a Python proof-of-reserves. No subgraph/Ponder/indexer repo found.

name: Railgun

repos.scope: RAILGUN V3 events (Shield/Unshield/Transact) across Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum
repos.verified: Repo contains subgraph.yaml + schema.graphql + ABIs + Matchstick tests; networks.json defines railgun-v3-ethereum/polygon/bsc/arbitrum deployments indexing RAILGUN smart contracts. ~7 commits, low activity.
Listed in Railgun-Community org as RAILGUN v2 event indexing template alongside v3 template.
Official Railgun-Community repo described as Subsquid indexing platform integration.

notes: Official Railgun-Community org maintains The Graph subgraph templates (v2 + v3) and a Subsquid integration indexing RAILGUN privacy contracts on Ethereum/Arbitrum/BSC/Polygon (matches protocol chains).

name: Bybit Staked SOL
notes: Solana-only CEX-operated LST (Bybit Web3). Custodial, no public EVM-style indexer or open-source repo.

name: SoSoValue Indexes
notes: Centralized crypto index product (SSI). No public protocol repo or indexer found.

name: River Omni-CDP
notes: River (Satoshi-Protocol org) has satoshi-core (CDP contracts), satoshi-farm, satoshi-sdk (TS) and audit repo. No subgraph/Ponder/indexer repo; satoshi-sdk reads on-chain state directly rather than via a public indexer.

name: infiniFi
notes: InfiniFi-Labs org has infinifi-protocol (Solidity) plus various Pendle/Ethena adapter forks and DefiLlama adapters. 'railway-monorepo' is labeled a pre-existing indexer from Revest, not an infiniFi-specific indexer. No dedicated public subgraph/indexer for infiniFi found.

name: Nexus Mutual
notes: NexusMutual org has smart-contracts, sdk, cover-router, dune-queries (Dune SQL analytics), but no The Graph subgraph / Ponder / SubQuery / Subsquid indexer repo. Data tooling is Dune-based + SDK reading chain state.

name: PancakeSwap Infinity

repos.scope: PancakeSwap exchange subgraphs (v3 CLMM family) on The Graph Studio
repos.verified: Official pancakeswap org subgraph repo (updated Jul 2025) for v3-style concentrated-liquidity exchange data; same CLAMM lineage Infinity builds on.

repos.scope: Pancake subgraphs (blocks, profile, prediction, NFTs, exchange)
repos.verified: Official pancakeswap subgraph monorepo (updated Aug 2025). Confirmed The Graph subgraphs maintained by PancakeSwap.

notes: PancakeSwap officially maintains The Graph subgraphs (pancake-subgraph, exchange-v3-subgraphs). A live 'PancakeSwap Infinity CL' subgraph is deployed on The Graph network (CL pools on BSC/Arbitrum), confirming Infinity indexing exists; however a dedicated open-source 'infinity-subgraph' source repo was not located, only the deployed subgraph + the v3/exchange subgraph source. Ambiguity: Infinity-specific source repo not publicly found.

name: Lulo
notes: Solana-only stablecoin yield aggregator. lulo-labs org has SDK-style repos (solana-go, lulo-xnft, solana-hammer) and a RESTful API; no public subgraph/indexer. Underlying positions live on Morpho/Kamino/Maple etc.

name: Loopscale
notes: Solana-only lending. LoopscaleLabs org is mostly forks (anchor, raydium-clmm, whirlpools, marginfi-v2, wormhole) plus pricing adapters, amm-sdk, audits. yellowstone-grpc is a fork of Solana geyser gRPC, not a Loopscale-specific public indexer. No dedicated public subgraph/indexer for Loopscale found.

name: Enzyme Finance

repos.scope: Official Enzyme subgraphs (enzyme-core vault indexing, vault-balances/shares/lineage, asset-universe, diva-staking, mln-token) on Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum
repos.verified: Official repo 'The official subgraphs of the Enzyme protocol'; ~311 commits; multiple subgraph.yaml/schema.graphql packages indexing Enzyme vault contracts across ETH/Polygon/Arbitrum (matches protocol chains).

notes: Official multi-subgraph monorepo actively maintained, indexing Enzyme vault contracts on Ethereum, Polygon, and Arbitrum. (Archived 'substreams' repo was an earlier Rust indexing approach.)

name: APX Bridge
notes: APX Finance / Aster (asterdex org) bridge product. asterdex public repos are API docs and exchange-related; no public subgraph/indexer for the bridge found. Bridge accounting is largely off-chain/CEX-style.

name: Stargate V2
notes: stargate-protocol org has stargate-v2 (Solidity contracts), stargate-dao, SDKs, and tutorials, but NO public subgraph/Ponder/SubQuery/Subsquid indexer repo. Cross-chain message tracking relies on LayerZero Scan + Stargate API, not a public indexer repo. (Community Messari/other subgraphs may exist but none official.)

name: Frax USD
notes: FraxFinance maintains fraxswap-subgraph (DEX, 2022) and fns-subgraph (name service), but NO subgraph dedicated to the frxUSD / Frax USD stablecoin RWA product. No public indexer specific to Frax USD found.

name: BYDFi
notes: Centralized exchange. Custodial wallet balances; no public on-chain indexer applicable.

name: Liquity V2

repos.scope: Liquity V2 (BOLD) CDP contracts (Troves/BorrowerOperations/StabilityPool) on Ethereum
repos.verified: Official liquity/bold monorepo subgraph dir contains subgraph.yaml + schema.graphql + src/ mappings + addresses.ts for BOLD deployment; README documents running the V2 subgraph. Active repo.

notes: Official Liquity V2 subgraph lives in the liquity/bold monorepo (subgraph/ directory) indexing BOLD CDP contracts on Ethereum. Actively maintained.

name: Polygon zkEVM Bridge
notes: Canonical L1<>L2 bridge for Polygon zkEVM. No protocol-specific public subgraph/indexer; bridge state tracked via Polygon's own infra/explorers. Out of scope per heuristic (canonical bridge).

name: BlazeStake
notes: Solana-only liquid staking (bSOL / SolBlaze). No EVM-style public subgraph/indexer; data via Solana RPC / stake pool program. No dedicated public indexer repo found.

name: Project 0
notes: Solana-only DeFi-native prime broker / lending (0.xyz, 0dotxyz org). Org has a DEX super-aggregator and SDK tooling but no public subgraph/indexer. Solana program; no EVM-style indexer found.

name: Zest V2
notes: Stacks (Bitcoin L2) lending protocol. Zest-Protocol org has zest-contracts written in Clarity (non-EVM) plus audit repos; no subgraph/Ponder/SubQuery/Subsquid indexer. The Graph does not support Stacks/Clarity. No public indexer found.

name: sDAI
notes: Savings xDAI on Gnosis Chain (0xaf2047...3701): an ERC4626 wrapper that routes bridged DAI into Maker DSR / Spark sDAI. Not a standalone protocol with its own repo; no dedicated public subgraph/indexer for sDAI on Gnosis found. Activity is observable via Spark/Maker subgraphs and GnosisScan but nothing sDAI-specific.

name: YBTC.B
notes: Bitlayer wrapped/anchor BTC token. Token-wrapper / bridged BTC representation, custodial-style; no protocol-specific public subgraph/indexer found. Out of scope per token-wrapper heuristic.

name: Galaxy Curation
notes: Risk curator (Galaxy Digital) operating curated vaults on Morpho-style lending (Ethereum/Base). No own protocol contracts and no Galaxy-specific public indexer; vault positions are indexed by the host protocols' own subgraphs (e.g. Morpho).

name: Arrakis Modular
notes: ArrakisFinance org has contracts (v2-core, infinity-periphery, etc.) and a Dune CLI but NO subgraph/indexer repo. A community Messari subgraph (messari/subgraphs/arrakis-finance) exists but indexes the older Arrakis v1/v2 Uniswap-v3 vaults (tracks rebalance/burn fee events), NOT the Arrakis Modular vault standard; that Messari subgraphs project is itself effectively deprecated/stale. No public indexer verified to cover Arrakis Modular specifically.
